notes.title: [Official Version 11th Update] The Spring Festival is here! Celebrate the New Ye
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, my fellow gamers! Gods' War Chronicles here, wishing you all a happy new year in advance! Happy New Year to all! This time around, Gods' War Chronicles is bringing you a Spring Festival version so you can enjoy your New Year's Eve dinner in-game while continuing to grind and have fun!

Details of the Spring Festival Version are as Follows:

Additions

Added Spring Festival elements to the game. Wishing everyone a Happy New Year!

Improved image clarity.
Reduced the size of pets such as the Magic Wolf and Giant Dragon.

notes.title: November 5th! The official version of War of the Gods: Infinite Epic goes live!
notes.notes:
Hello players and friends! After 13 years of inheritance, the latest masterpiece of War of the Gods, War of the Gods: Infinite Epic, will be launched on November 5th! 30+ gameplay experience, 9 major characters, 600+ equipment with different attributes, 200+ pets, 180+ artifacts, bringing you a large amount of equipment to build, and the experience of creating your own school of play!

At the same time of the official launch, all the archives will be inherited, as well as the opening of the first week of 20% discount activities (after discount 33 yuan).	

The official version of the game will also bring new content to continue our tradition of “big and full”:
1. two new characters.
2. 6 new maps.
3. 17 new companions.
4. 60 new gears.
5.14 new artifacts!

Please enjoy the anticipation and we'll see you on November 5th!

notes.title: V0.9005 Update Notice

Battle of Gods” Mid-Autumn Festival Update Announcement
Hello to all the players of “War of the Gods”! It's almost Mid-Autumn Festival, can't you wait to go home and play the game? During this period of time, we have been seriously collecting players' opinions and making changes. Finally, on the eve of the Mid-Autumn Festival, Battle of Gods: Infinite Epic v0.9005 will be released!
The content of this update is as follows:

New:
Added: The selection of artifacts in the main city has been archived, so you don't have to re-select them every time you die.
Added: A new button for level 5 in one go has been added to Talents.
Added: You can see the game difficulty directly at the totem in the main city.
Added: Expanded the size of the backpack to 30 compartments.

Optimize.
Optimize: Optimize the map interface, now you can clearly distinguish the different areas of each world.
Optimized: Optimized the map interface and expanded the viewable area.
Optimized: Added bomb drops.
Optimized: Pressing space can start the game, and you can have a conversation.
Optimized: Multi-weekly, changed to multi-world, first world.
Optimized: Removed bomb tips, all buildings can be bombed.
Optimize: Pseudo random, all skill mechanism, all game mechanism can be experienced in advance.
OPTIMIZE: No more clearing equipment after winning in the current world.
OPTIMIZE: When using joystick, the current selection will not go back to the first one after selling in the selling interface.
Optimized: Adjusted the playing order of background music so that the same music will not be played repeatedly.

BUG FIX.
Bug fix: Fixed tutorial key tutorial skill training bug.

Lastly, thank you for your love and support for the “War of the Gods”, and I wish you all a happy Mid-Autumn Festival in advance, and have fun!

notes.title: EA V8825 patch notes（April, 13th, 2024）
notes.notes:
1.	Add double dash for characters.
2.	Increase the pre-dash speed, now you can dash immediately after attacking.
3.	Hunter racial bonus changed to increase the maximum number of companions summoned by 1/2/3/4.
4.	Fixed the issue causing the arena to freeze.

notes.title: EA V8824 patch notes（April, 9th, 2024）
notes.notes:
1. The mages bonus has been changed to affect the number of projectiles.
2. The Druid bonus has been changed to elemental damage, removing the reflected damage bonus
3.Fixed the issue with boss attack intervals. Melee classes can now properly respond to boss attacks.
4. Increased the probability and amount of health recovery on Leon's basic attacks.
5. Fixed the bug where the Boss's life steal resistance wasn't functioning.
6. Added the Miner Set - Bomber man, increased bomb damage attributes in artifacts, now you can play as a bomber.
7. A limit has been set on the number of companions that can be deployed. You can now manually choose which companions to deploy from the companion menu.
8. Epic and Legendary companions have received significant buffs in combat. Companions can now draw monster aggro and block some ranged monster skills. The racial bonuses for companions remain unchanged, and all companions can contribute passive attributes to the main character.
9. Dismissing companions now returns gold. The higher the level of the stage, the more gold returned.
10. Reduced the damage and cooldown of certain skills for Sand Throat, Skull King, Medusa, Ice Goddess, and Bloody Goddess.
11. Modified the talent 'God of the Giant Eagle.' Now, you must acquire the prefix 'Companion Increases Character Attack Power' from equipment and artifacts.
12. Increased the resistance of equipment and enhanced the initial resistance of all characters. You now have more elemental defense.
13. Fixed the issue where items wouldn't refresh in the item shop after destroying furniture.
14. Fixed the issue where resurrection talent wouldn't trigger correctly.
15. Increased the efficiency of divine skill charging, you can now gain charges from hitting targets.
16. Characters gain additional shield increase and duration extension upon revival.
17. Controllers now have automatic 360-degree aiming.
18. Added resolutions: 2160x1080, 2880x1440.
19. Fixed the issue where controllers couldn't scroll in the companion interface.
20. Increased the pickup range for gold coins and soul crystals.
21. Fixed the issue causing a crash when triggering Miss Lan in the English version.
